text:
Landed 9e053f31 on main (single-developer mode, self-reported gate, LocallyObserved).

Gate: embedBench/test 98/98 with pinned MiniLM artifacts present; scalafmtCheckAll clean. The
general courts moved into RecallToVideoSuite (5) and gained two capabilities Sherlock never
exercises: a flat annotation (no groups) builds a leaf-only view, and a group hull is minted
on the part's own axis and refused without one. Sherlock adapter suite 7/7 including the
env-gated neural court.

Behavior preservation, measured not asserted: the NN01 report regenerated through the
refactored path is byte-identical to the pre-refactor artifact in all data rows
(diff on tail -n +2); only the two intentionally renamed header cells differ
(scene -> group, annotationDescription -> sourceSegmentText). All 33 reports regenerated
under the new headers, exit 0, 33/33 printing the neural channel identity.

Generality now compiled, not claimed: no type in bench.video references Sherlock; the
Sherlock file converts its atlas to TimedSegments and calls the general runner. Seconds and
timecodes derive per part from each axis's own rational timebase - the global ticks-per-second
assumption is gone; an axis without a timebase renders empty cells rather than a fabricated
scale.

Not established / follow-ups: bench.video promotion to a portable module needs an ADR and a
second consumer; a perception-channel adapter (VLM captions -> TimedSegments) is the path for
videos with no human annotation; RecallWordsCsv still reads only the Zenodo word-CSV shape,
and other transcript formats get their own parsers at the adapter layer.
